title: Cloud Courier
premise: A cheerful sky-delivery arcade game where a small courier character hops across floating platforms above the clouds, rescuing lost package tags while an endless route scrolls forward.
interaction_model: One-button auto-scrolling platform runner controlled with tap/click or Space; the player performs up to two jumps before landing again.
objective: Stay alive as long as possible, land on procedurally generated platforms, and collect floating package pickups to maximize score.
progression: Each run begins from a start screen, transitions into an endless forward-scrolling run with increasing score over distance plus pickup bonuses, then ends on a fall and loops into a restart flow with persistent best score.
theme: Futuristic sky courier adventure with bright clouds, floating routes, package recovery, and arcade delivery framing.
mood: Light, upbeat, energetic, and breezy, with celebratory pickup feedback and a soft failure tone rather than harsh punishment.
likely_audience: fans of short replayable runner/platformer games
players who enjoy simple controls and score chasing
confidence_notes: High confidence in the endless runner/platformer structure because the code explicitly implements auto-scroll, procedural platforms, double jump, collectible scoring, and game-over on falling.
Moderate confidence in the exact fiction because the internal variable names call pickups coins, but the title and UI text consistently present them as package tags or deliveries.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished single-screen HTML5 canvas arcade game called "Cloud Courier" where the player controls a cute airborne courier character in a bright futuristic sky. The world should auto-scroll from left to right like an endless runner, while the character stays near the left side of the screen and must hop between procedurally generated floating platforms. Use simple one-button controls: tap/click on the canvas or press Space to jump, with a double-jump allowed before landing. Apply gravity-based physics so the player must time jumps carefully to clear gaps and recover in midair. Scatter floating collectible package tags above or near many platforms; collecting one should award a big score bonus and trigger a flashy positive response with particles, sound, and a small celebratory feedback card. Increase score continuously from distance traveled as well. If the player falls below the bottom of the screen, end the run immediately, play a fail effect, show a game-over panel with the run score and a persistent best score, and allow instant restart. Present the game with a glowing sky gradient, soft parallax cloud shapes, rounded glassy HUD panels, a route score counter, upbeat looping music, juicy jump/land/pickup/death sound effects, squash-and-stretch and rotation on the character, and a cheerful high-contrast sci-fi UI that feels mobile safe and replayable in short sessions.
